must_identify.item: The api crash loop is caused by redis being unavailable, not by the api itself
must_identify.evidence: the app code (api.py, from ConfigMap api-code) does up to 5 Redis-ping retries at startup and sys.exit(1) ("giving up: redis unavailable") if it can't connect. With Redis down, it exits 1 every time → CrashLoopBackOff

must_identify.item: redis is Pending because its PVC requests storage class fast-ssd, which does not exist
must_identify.evidence: StorageClass fast-ssd does not exist in cluster kind-aurora-lab (only the default standard / rancher.io/local-path SC exists). PVC redis-data is stuck Pending

notes: The RCA also offers creating a fast-ssd StorageClass as an alternative fix, which is reasonable but not in the acceptable list. Its primary fix, switching to standard, is acceptable. The investigator's claim that the api was rollout-restarted is incidental detail and does not affect the diagnosis.
